prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, new_screen] Sign In Account Recovery Prompt Screen: Adds an account sync introduction screen right before sign-in explaining cloud pet protection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_recovery", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pets", "body": "Connecting your account ensures your desktop companions are safely saved to the cloud."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Grid Layout Choose Path Redesign: Redesigns the choose path screen layout into a clear grid format contrasting photo custom pets and instant pre-made pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Pick Your Companion Journey", "body": "Choose between instant adoption of starter pets or creating a unique pet from your photos."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Selection Stage Flow: Inserts a pet personality trait selection screen right after choosing a base pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_traits", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Select Base Companion", "body": "Pick your favorite species, then choose their unique personality traits."}}
3: [home, redesign] Centered Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen with a centered layout and explicit generation status progress indicator.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is being initialized. This typically takes 1 to 2 minutes.", "show_progress": true}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Security Reassurance Hint: Adds a explicit hint text beneath sign-in options confirming pet data cloud persistence.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in secures your pets in the cloud so you never lose them when switching devices."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Notification Option: Enables desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can multitask while pet generates.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize the app. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Starter Bonus Badge: Adds a playful starter item badge component on the adoption certificate screen to reward completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Welcome your new pet! Your certificate includes an exclusive starter accessory.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Free Starter Gift Included", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [finish, layout] Compact Layout Home Intro Screen: Changes home_intro layout to compact mode with an embedded desktop controls tip carousel component.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Right-click your pet anywhere on the desktop to open options, hide them, or interact.", "style": "rounded"}]}}
8: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Story Overview Description: Updates story screen hint to explicitly clarify that custom photo pets can be created anytime later.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Choose how you want to meet your new desktop companion.", "hint": "Don't worry, you can create more pets or switch paths anytime later in settings."}}
9: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Photo Upload Screen Redesign: Redesigns upload_photos layout to split view with clear photographic guidelines and photo quality tips.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Upload Pet Photos", "body": "Provide 1-3 clear, well-lit photos of your pet for optimal custom generation.", "hint": "Front-facing photos with uncluttered backgrounds produce the best results."}}

verdicts.reason: The new screen added before sign-in is allowed inside onboarding and all required steps are retained.
The redesigned choose path screen continues to offer both adopting pre-made pets and creating custom ones.
Adding a personality selection step after pick_friend is a valid addition inside onboarding.
The redesigned waiting screen continues to show that the pet is being prepared.
Adding a security hint text to the sign-in screen is valid and does not violate any rules.
Adding a desktop notification option on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras and gifts ('Free Starter Gift Included'), violating Rule 3.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout with a tips carousel is valid inside onboarding.
Updating hint copy on the story screen is permitted.
Redesigning the photo upload screen to a split layout retains its original job.
